verdict.rationale: Slack's Events API explicitly supports webhook-style event subscriptions ('Slack calls you'), with the ability to subscribe to specific events and receive them via a public HTTP endpoint or Socket Mode, plus Workflow Builder's webhook triggers for external event kick-off — both well-documented first-party capabilities directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the Events API webhook flow (only the Web API and MCP endpoints were probed live) and more detail on event payload/subscription management UX.
